s: concept (something understood, and retained in the mind)
to be able (to do or be something), to have the possibility of, can.
Are you able to help him?
to be able to do something implied; can.

Kommst du zur Party?
— Nein, ich kann nicht.

Are you coming to the party?
— No, I can’t.

to know how to do (something); to know; to understand; to be able to do (something); to be capable of; can do (something), to have a specific skill. (which is notably unlike in English where another verb is needed for a main verb)
to be possible, to make sense
Nächstes Jahr is’n Schaltjahr. – Das kann nich’. Letztes Jahr war doch Schaltjahr!
Next year is a leap year. – That’s not possible. Last year was a leap year!
to be allowed (to do something); to be permitted (to do something); may.
Er hat nicht ins Kino gehen können.
He was not allowed to go to the cinema.
to be in the legal situation of being able to realize a legal effect even if it be legally disallowed
to be to blame, to be at fault
Ich kann nichts dafür, dass das passiert ist.
It's not my fault that happened.
Er kann nicht wirklich etwas für das Verhalten seiner Familie.
He's not really to blame for his family's behavior.

Das Konsumklima in Deutschland ist auf den tiefsten Stand seit Jahren gefallen.
Consumer confidence in Germany has fallen to its lowest level in years.
business cycle, economic cycle (the downward and upward movement of gross domestic product around its long-term growth trend)
Die Analyse des aktuellen Konjunkturzyklus ist entscheidend für die Zinspolitik der Zentralbank.
The analysis of the current business cycle is crucial for the central bank's interest rate policy.
consumer society (a society in which the consumption of goods and services is the primary social and economic activity)
Die moderne Konsumgesellschaft ist durch eine ständige Verfügbarkeit von Waren geprägt.
The modern consumer society is characterized by the constant availability of goods.
Kritiker sehen in der Konsumgesellschaft eine Ursache für die globale Umweltkrise.
Critics see the consumer society as a cause of the global environmental crisis.
consumer restraint, reluctance to consume (a situation where consumers spend less money than usual, often due to economic uncertainty, inflation, or low consumer confidence)
Die anhaltende Inflation führt zu einer spürbaren Konsumzurückhaltung bei langlebigen Wirtschaftsgütern.
Persistent inflation is leading to noticeable consumer restraint regarding durable goods.
Einzelhändler klagen über die Konsumzurückhaltung der Bürger im Vorfeld der Steuerreform.
Retailers are complaining about the citizens' reluctance to consume in the run-up to the tax reform.
economic downturn, recessionary trend, decline in economic activity (a phase in the business cycle characterized by slowing growth, decreasing demand, and falling production)
Der drohende Konjunkturrückgang veranlasste die Regierung zu einem umfangreichen Konjunkturpaket.
The looming economic downturn prompted the government to launch an extensive stimulus package.
Unternehmen reagieren auf einen Konjunkturrückgang oft mit Einstellungsstopps und Investitionskürzungen.
Companies often react to an economic downturn with hiring freezes and investment cuts.
economic upswing, economic recovery, expansion (a period of increasing economic activity, characterized by rising production, higher employment, and growing demand)
Nach der langen Phase der Stagnation hoffen alle Marktteilnehmer auf einen nachhaltigen Konjunkturaufschwung.
After the long phase of stagnation, all market participants are hoping for a sustainable economic recovery.
Ein kräftiger Konjunkturaufschwung führt meist zu steigenden Steuereinnahmen und einer Entlastung der Sozialsysteme.
A strong economic upswing usually leads to rising tax revenues and relief for social systems.
economic downturn, recessionary phase (a period in the business cycle following a peak, characterized by slowing economic growth, decreasing orders, and declining business confidence)
Ein frühzeitiges Erkennen des Konjunkturabschwungs ermöglicht es Unternehmen, ihre Lagerbestände rechtzeitig zu reduzieren.
Early detection of the economic downturn allows companies to reduce their inventories in time.
Der Konjunkturabschwung traf die exportorientierte Maschinenbaubranche besonders hart.
The economic downturn hit the export-oriented mechanical engineering sector particularly hard.
anti-cyclical policy, economic policy (the totality of measures taken by the state to influence economic fluctuations and ensure stable growth)
In einer Rezession greift der Staat oft zu einer expansiven Konjunkturpolitik.
In a recession, the state often resorts to an expansive economic policy.
Das Hauptziel der Konjunkturpolitik ist die Vermeidung von Arbeitslosigkeit und Inflation.
The main goal of economic policy is the avoidance of unemployment and inflation.
Konjunkturpolitik.et: Konjunktur (“economic cycle; conjuncture”) + -s- (“genitival interfix”) + Politik (“policy; politics”)
